title: Omar Khayyam (Encyclopaedia Britannica, 1911)
summary: Omar Khayyam (about 1048 to 1131) as the 1911 Britannica saw him: the mathematician who classified cubic equations, the astronomer who reformed the Persian calendar at Isfahan, and the poet of the quatrains that FitzGerald made famous. Useful alongside the Rubaiyat itself.
